note: RV park on Hwy 112 three miles north of Roaring River State Park: back-in gravel sites 60-90 ft long on an open loop behind the store, with a shower house; also tent sites, cabins, glamping tents and a rental trailer. Small catch-and-release fishing ponds. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the operator's site and its Let's Camp engine: 25 back-in full-hookup sites (20/30/50A), open year-round, RV $45/night flat for 2 adults + 2 children, extra adult $5 / child $3, one vehicle per site, 3-night minimum on holidays/events only. Under the $50 gate at the posted rate. Google 4.7 over 56. Hookups, sites, season, booking and extra-person fee written; phone and website match; not waterfront stands; pin is in the loop.
flags: PRICE: the only RV rate posted is a flat $45/night and the engine's 'from' price is $45; no holiday, event or trout-opener rate is posted. A dated priced search in the Let's Camp engine was NOT run (its search endpoint was not read), so a holiday surcharge inside the engine cannot be ruled out. No gateway within 40 km.

LONG-STAY CHECK: the policies mention 'Registration tags/Stickers for Seasonal', so some seasonal sites exist, but the park sells nightly online with a one-night minimum, and the leaf-off imagery frame shows the 25-pad loop nearly empty (3-4 units). Reads as a nightly park. The seasonal share is not published.
RATINGS: Google 4.7 over 56 (was 4.7 over 50). RV Life was not re-read this pass (stored: not on RV Life).
WATERFRONT (stands, not waterfront): open pasture loop; a farm pond of about 45 x 50 m lies ~30 m south of the last pads ('Ponds are for fishing only'), which is not a waterfront setting.

The engine's own coordinate (36.62050,-93.85068) is the store on the highway; the stored pin 36.6195,-93.8512 is in the middle of the RV loop, left as is. A second phone, 417-501-4787, is listed beside the stored 417-671-4295.
